title: nr-vault: overview film
description: Encrypted secrets with an audit log. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 51 seconds: nr-vault for TYPO3 v14. Listed, never shown; A check that names fixes; Every access on record. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Sites connect to AI providers and payment services, and their API keys often sit in plain text.
nr-vault keeps them encrypted inside TYPO3, each secret with its own key.
The Secrets module lists each key with its owner and read count, never its value.
A readiness check confirms the encryption and names the fix for each open control.
Every read, API call and denied attempt goes into a hash-chained audit log.
nr-vault by Netresearch. Encrypted keys, and a record of every read.
